items.q: What is the penalty if I break my FD early?
items.answer: Breaking an FD early pays the rate for the period the money actually stayed, minus a 1% penalty [03_fixed_deposits#premature-withdrawal]. FDs broken within 7 days earn no interest at all [03_fixed_deposits#premature-withdrawal]. There's no penalty on FDs of Rs 5 lakh or less broken to fund a medical emergency, with hospital proof [03_fixed_deposits#premature-withdrawal]. Note that the 5-year tax saver FD has no premature withdrawal option [03_fixed_deposits#tax-saver-fd].

items.q: My card bill is 12,000 and I paid late. What fee will I pay?
items.answer: For a statement balance of Rs 12,000, the late payment fee is Rs 500 [04_credit_card#late-payment-fee]. It is charged only if the minimum amount due (5% of the outstanding or Rs 200, whichever is higher) is not paid within 3 days of the due date [04_credit_card#late-payment-fee][04_credit_card#minimum-amount-due]. Any unpaid balance also attracts interest of 3.6% a month from the transaction date [04_credit_card#interest-and-grace-period].

items.q: How long do I have to dispute an order that never arrived on my card?
items.answer: You have 120 days from the transaction date to raise a card dispute for goods not received [06_disputes_and_fraud#card-chargeback]. The bank then sends the chargeback to the card network within 5 working days, and the final outcome is usually known in 45 to 90 days [06_disputes_and_fraud#card-chargeback].

items.q: What is the lowest monthly SIP amount?
items.answer: The smallest SIP through Tunga Bank is Rs 500 a month [07_mutual_funds_sip#starting-a-sip].

items.q: What FD rate does a 65 year old get for one year?
items.answer: A 1-year FD (1 year to under 2 years) pays 7.1% a year for the general public [03_fixed_deposits#interest-rates], and senior citizens aged 60 and above get an extra 0.5% on every tenure [03_fixed_deposits#interest-rates], so at 65 you'd get 7.6%.

items.q: What is the daily ATM limit on the platinum debit card?
items.answer: The Platinum debit card has a daily ATM withdrawal limit of Rs 1 lakh [09_debit_card_and_atm#card-variants].

items.q: How many nominees can I add to my FD?
items.answer: You can add up to 4 nominees to an FD, with shares split in percentages that add up to 100 [08_kyc_and_nominee#nominee]. Nominees can be changed any time from the app at no cost [08_kyc_and_nominee#nominee].

items.q: What does a cash withdrawal on the Neem credit card cost?
items.answer: A cash withdrawal on the Neem credit card costs 2.5% of the amount, with a minimum of Rs 500 [04_credit_card#cash-advance]. There is no interest-free period on cash advances, and the cash limit is 40% of your credit limit [04_credit_card#cash-advance].

items.q: If a UPI payment fails and is not reversed in time, what compensation do I get?
items.answer: If a UPI payment is debited but the merchant doesn't receive it, the amount is auto-reversed within T+1 working day [02_upi_and_transfers#upi-failures-and-reversals]. If the reversal doesn't happen, the bank pays Rs 100 per day of delay after T+1, credited automatically without a claim [02_upi_and_transfers#upi-failures-and-reversals].

items.q: What is the processing fee on a home loan?
items.answer: The processing fee is 0.5% of the loan amount, capped at Rs 10,000, plus GST [10_home_loan#processing-fee]. It's waived on balance transfers above Rs 50 lakh [10_home_loan#balance-transfer].

items.q: How much can a newly added beneficiary receive in the first day?
items.answer: A newly added beneficiary can receive at most Rs 50,000 in the first 24 hours [02_upi_and_transfers#adding-a-beneficiary].

items.q: Within how many days of disbursal can I cancel a personal loan without penalty?
items.answer: You can cancel within 3 days of disbursal by repaying the principal plus proportionate interest, with no penalty [05_personal_loan#cooling-off-period]. The processing fee is refunded except Rs 999 [05_personal_loan#cooling-off-period].
